name: Breaker
summary: A destructive barbarian who turns broken and improvised weapons into tools of devastation.

features.name: Destructive
features.summary: Add half your barbarian level (minimum +1) to melee damage against unattended objects and on sunder combat maneuvers.

features.name: Battle Scavenger
features.summary: Take no attack penalty with improvised weapons or weapons with the broken condition.

features.name: Battle Scavenger +1
features.summary: Gain +1 damage with improvised weapons and weapons with the broken condition.

features.name: Battle Scavenger +2
features.summary: Gain +2 damage with improvised weapons and weapons with the broken condition.

features.name: Battle Scavenger +3
features.summary: Gain +3 damage with improvised weapons and weapons with the broken condition.

features.name: Battle Scavenger +4
features.summary: Gain +4 damage with improvised weapons and weapons with the broken condition.

features.name: Battle Scavenger +5
features.summary: Gain +5 damage with improvised weapons and weapons with the broken condition.
